summary: Gathered the results of the parallel subagents implementing the `display` tool with optional input, then took over directly to run workspace checks and focused tests instead of further subagents. Confirmed the implementation is in place and tests pass, then began running the backfill-agent-journal skill to catch up the journal and prepare to commit all current changes.
decisions: Stopped further use of multiple subagents for this feature; the assistant will handle remaining integration review and verification directly.
Confirmed `display` semantics: confirm `false` means No or dismissed (indistinguishable), abort means cancelled, and the display is published before awaiting optional input.
Journal is git-ignored by project policy, so it is updated locally and excluded from the commit.
errors: Workspace `pnpm check` completed but the combined full-test rerun (`pnpm --filter @gizmo/app exec vitest run`) timed out at 120 seconds; assistant then read the partial log to confirm there were no reported failures up to that point.

A shell command exited with code 1 due to a missing file path (`cat apps/agent-server/src/tools/display-tool.ts` did not exist); the actual `display` source lived at `apps/agent-server/src/pi-extensions/display.ts`.
